about_the_game:
This game will act as an expansion of "VHS Bodycam: The Torture Machine" and will feature longer gameplay.

Immersive yourself in a collection of four classified tapes that hold bodycam footage of unexplainable tragedies. You play as experts sitting behind computers who guide groups of SWAT teams, industry professionals, and experts who plunge themselves head-first into bizarre incidents to uncover the horror behind it all. 

Monitor and assist your team by:

  • remotely controlling devices

  • navigating the routes

  • analyzing the environment

Disclaimer

This game being released is likely contingent on me finding a publisher since this project will require a lot more development time. As is, I can only justify make smaller scale games with my free time, so a larger release would require help from a 3rd party.

If you want more "VHS Bodycam" content, then be sure to wishlist!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains body horror, blood, and violence.
